validation.notes: Repaired packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts: migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot() used 'if (existsSync(newPath)) return;' inside its per-file loop, so the first legacy ~/.pi/agent/*.jsonl session whose computed destination name was already taken aborted the entire migration batch and every later file stayed in the legacy agent root. The statement is now 'if (existsSync(newPath)) continue;' (only that one statement plus an explanatory comment changed; 1 file, +4/-1 lines), so a colliding file is skipped on its own, the legacy copy is left in place, the pre-existing destination is never overwritten (both copies preserved), the rest of the batch still migrates, malformed/header-less files are still skipped untouched by the pre-existing 'continue' guards, and repeated runs are no-ops. The regression loads the real production module through .prale-eval/subject.mjs createGraph (only the fs boundary is faked with an in-memory filesystem; sibling imports cfg getAgentDir/getBinDir/CONFIG_DIR_NAME, chalk, migrateKeybindingsConfig and utils/text stripBom are inert stand-ins) and calls the real migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot(). It builds a 9-file legacy batch (3 migratable sessions, 2 collisions whose destinations already hold distinct 'ORIGINAL:<name>' bytes, malformed JSON, session-less header, empty file, non-.jsonl file) and replays three batch orders (alphabetical, reversed, collisions-first) plus a collision-only batch and a collision-free batch. Assertions: every non-colliding session reaches sessions/--<encoded-cwd>--/ with byte-identical content and is gone from the agent root; each colliding legacy file still exists with its original bytes and its destination still holds the original bytes; no renameSync overwrote an existing file (the fake fs records overwrites and asserts that list is empty); malformed/header-less/empty files and the non-.jsonl file stay untouched and are never copied into a session dir; the agent root afterwards contains exactly the skipped colliding files plus the malformed ones; and a second run leaves a byte-for-byte identical file snapshot with no overwrites. Bidirectional verification performed locally: with the original fault temporarily restored the script exits 1 on AssertionError 'batch order "alphabetical": c-fresh-2.jsonl was not migrated to /fake/home/.pi/agent/sessions/--work-proj--/c-fresh-2.jsonl - a collision earlier in the batch aborted migration of later files'; with the fix in place it exits 0 with 'all assertions passed'. Environment: Node v24.14.0, workspace root as cwd, no dependencies or network. Limitation: the vitest packages/coding-agent suite (test/session-manager/migration.test.ts) was not run because node_modules is not installed in this workspace and installing dependencies is out of scope, so verification is limited to this standalone script plus the hidden production-behavior oracle.
